events.title: MTV Launched
events.blurb: On August 1, 1981, MTV, the iconic music television channel, first went on air, broadcasting "Video Killed The Radio Star" by The Buggles as its inaugural music video.

angles.name: MTV Launch
angles.copy: Remember the day music TV changed everything? MTV launched with The Buggles' 'Video Killed The Radio Star'. The irony isn't lost on us, nearly 45 years later!

events.title: Oasis' 'Definitely Maybe' Anniversary
events.blurb: Oasis released their debut album, 'Definitely Maybe', on August 29, 1994, which quickly became a Britpop classic and the fastest-selling debut album in British history at the time.

angles.name: Definitely Maybe
angles.copy: Oasis's debut album 'Definitely Maybe' turns 32 this month! What's your favourite track from this Britpop masterpiece?

events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Music & Art Fair, a pivotal moment in music history, took place from August 15 to 18, 1969, attracting over 400,000 attendees to a dairy farm in Bethel, New York.

angles.name: Woodstock
angles.copy: 57 years since half a million people gathered for '3 Days of Peace & Music' at Woodstock. Which iconic performance do you wish you'd seen live?

events.title: Elvis Presley's Passing Anniversary
events.blurb: The music world remembers the passing of Elvis Presley, the King of Rock and Roll, on August 16, 1977.

angles.name: Elvis Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the King today. Elvis Presley passed away on this date in 1977, but his music lives on.

events.title: Tupac Shakur's Passing Anniversary
events.blurb: The music world remembers the tragic passing of influential rapper Tupac Shakur on September 13, 1996, six days after being shot in Las Vegas.

angles.name: Tupac Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the legendary Tupac Shakur, who tragically passed away on this day in 1996. His impact on music is undeniable.

events.title: Jimi Hendrix's Passing Anniversary
events.blurb: The music world remembers the passing of guitar legend Jimi Hendrix on September 18, 1970.

angles.name: Jimi Hendrix Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the unparalleled talent of Jimi Hendrix, who left us too soon on this day in 1970. His legacy continues to inspire.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic eleventh studio album, 'Abbey Road', on September 26, 1969, featuring its famous zebra crossing cover.

angles.name: Abbey Road
angles.copy: The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' album turns 57 this month! What's your favourite track from this legendary LP?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, the influential American-British singer, songwriter, and founding member of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday.

angles.name: Chrissie Hynde Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the iconic Chrissie Hynde! Her voice and attitude with The Pretenders shaped decades of rock.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Liam Gallagher, the distinctive frontman of Oasis and a celebrated solo artist, celebrates his 54th birthday.

angles.name: Liam Gallagher Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! Still bringing the rock 'n' roll swagger.

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Single Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's powerful and timeless anthem 'Imagine' was released as a single in the UK in October 1975.

angles.name: Imagine Single
angles.copy: 49 years since John Lennon's 'Imagine' was released as a single. Its message of peace and unity resonates just as strongly today.

events.title: First iPod Announced Anniversary
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the first iPod on October 23, 2001, promising "1,000 songs in your pocket" and revolutionising portable music.

angles.name: iPod Launch
angles.copy: Remember when the first iPod dropped? 25 years ago, Apple changed how we listened to music forever. How many songs did you cram onto yours?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day celebrates the premiere of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', on October 5, 1962.

angles.name: James Bond Day
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! From the gadgets to the theme tunes, what's your favourite thing about 007?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: The music world remembers the birthday of The Beatles' legendary co-founder John Lennon, who would have been 86 today.

angles.name: John Lennon Birthday
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message of peace continue to inspire.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Legendary English comedian, actor, and writer John Cleese, a founding member of Monty Python, celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: John Cleese Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 87th birthday to the utterly brilliant John Cleese! What's your favourite Python sketch or Fawlty Towers moment?

events.title: The Beatles' "White Album" Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, famously known as the "White Album", on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album
angles.copy: The Beatles' 'White Album' turns 58 this November! Which experimental track or hidden gem is your go-to?
